title: La Reina Bubbaloo: su escenario, Aitor de su lado y el final
description: docs/castle-bosses.md § La Reina Bubbaloo. Her figure (Nuria Mendoza's face, src/monsters/reina.json) and portrait, her stage (src/throne-arena.ts), Aitor crossing to her side when she takes him and fighting from there with player 2's commands, the six notes bringing him back, and the last scene from the fight tester. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.gerard.game.setEnvironment('palacio-trono', { x: 13, z: 9 }); setTimeout(() => window.gerard.storyEvent({ type: 'near', id: 'castillo-reina' }), 2500)

steps.caption: She speaks with Nuria Mendoza's face: her portrait in the conversation before the fight

Her stage: the sala d'actes' boards with the footlights, the velvet, the banner, the balcony over the night city, and her throne (the bubble she blows, her core, the five flavours) with her gum spreading from it; her own figure in front
At her tenth she takes Aitor: he walks over to her side
On her side, facing Gerard; his card has crossed too, in possession's violet, «Del lado de la Reina»
Her turn is his: player 2 picks what Aitor does to Gerard
He runs at Gerard from her side, as a foe would, and goes back to stand by her
The six notes: the thread breaks and Aitor walks back to Gerard, his card back in the party
From the fight tester the ending plays on: the last scene, Acabar or Bajar la mano (then the Monday and the credits, with the save untouched)
